message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy after an earlier missile engagement by holding a fast, level eastward extension, which steadily increases lateral separation from the southeast-bound Team B missiles and continues unchanged after its recorded missile disappears as B0200 becomes inactive.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile engagement by diving through a hard right turn toward the southeast, creating vertical and crossing separation from Team B missiles approaching from the north; it continues this defensive displacement after its missile is removed as B0200 becomes inactive and B0100 remains northward."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy after an earlier missile engagement by holding a fast, level eastward extension, which steadily increases lateral separation from the southeast-bound Team B missiles and continues unchanged after its recorded missile disappears as B0200 becomes inactive.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure after an earlier missile engagement by diving through a hard right turn toward the southeast, creating vertical and crossing separation from Team B missiles approaching from the north; it continues this defensive displacement after its missile is removed as B0200 becomes inactive and B0100 remains northward.
